subject: Archaeology
title: Archaeology and Nationalism
description: A quick, practical guide to Archaeology and Nationalism.

hook.text: Governments love archaeology when it proves their nation is ancient. Otherwise it gets awkward.

buildup.text: Nazi Germany twisted archaeology to claim Aryan superiority. Himmler sent teams to prove it.

discovery.text: Today, some governments fund only research that supports national myths.

twist.text: DNA often reveals populations are more mixed than national stories claim.

climax.text: Ethics demand publishing findings regardless of political convenience.

punchline.text: Every nation wants a glorious past. Evidence does not always agree.

quiz.question: How has archaeology been misused politically?
options: By destroying sites that contradict national narratives
By funding only research that supports national myths
